title: Duplicate Check Navigation Permission Consistency

items.action: view the operations list and generic operation detail
create and immediately execute a duplicate-check operation
open the duplicate-check wizard and dataset result routes

migration.reason: Existing operation and data-operation permission codes are reused.

backend.reason: Existing operations.execute and admin.data_operations.read runtime authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No endpoint or payload contract changes are introduced.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

forms.reason: No form validation or payload shape changes.

notes: Duplicate-check creation is an immediate-execution path authorized by fair_crm.operations.execute, while its wizard and dataset result views also consume admin data-operation read APIs. The New Operation picker now exposes duplicate_check only when both route/runtime permissions are present. Operations-list users without admin.data_operations.read retain access to the generic operation detail; the stronger dataset-result shortcut is suppressed instead of navigating them into a route they cannot read.
